findings.issue: The explanation writes the image vertex with an ASCII apostrophe instead of the prime used in the crop, the alt, and the choices. To English learners it can look like a possessive.
findings.resolution: Repaired the explanation or notation, retaining the correct choice and providing the missing reasoning; synchronized source records and generated content.

findings.issue: Converting the caret to superscripts produced a nested superscript exponent that is hard to read at superscript size. The double negative inside it is the step the student needs to see. The value is still correct (2 − (−1) = 3).
findings.resolution: Repaired the explanation or notation, retaining the correct choice and providing the missing reasoning; synchronized source records and generated content.

findings.issue: The explanation uses the radii 2.25 and 1.5 without saying they are half of the given diameters. Using the diameter instead of the radius gives distractor C (75.2), so this is the step most students need. Also, 2.25 equals 1.5², which may confuse students who see '(2.25)²' next to '(1.5)²'.
findings.resolution: Repaired the explanation or notation, retaining the correct choice and providing the missing reasoning; synchronized source records and generated content.

findings.resolution: Repaired the explanation or notation, retaining the correct choice and providing the missing reasoning; synchronized source records and generated content.

findings.issue: PR #14 removed the “calculators allowed” footer from the 2015 G6/G8 Book-2 crops and G7 q21, but these 11 G7 crops still show it.
findings.resolution: Removed only the calculators-allowed footer from all 11 crops using exact-source, geometry-pinned rendering; every retained pixel is identical. Refreshed dimensions and source hashes.

findings.issue: The passage note (“Original booklet headers may show “XX” or different question numbers…”) now renders on all 242 ELA passages. The XX headers were removed from the images in this PR, and 2016–2026 use official numbering, so the note is stale/irrelevant almost everywhere; at most it applies to 2013–2015 release-ordinal numbering.
findings.resolution: Limited the numbering note to 2013–2015 releases and removed the obsolete XX reference.
